# End

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Runtime](BlitzBasic-Runtime)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
End
```

## Description

Stops the program right away. Everything that is output so far is written out first, and the exit code is 0.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print "before"
End
Print "never printed"
```

```text
before
```
